name: Shiraishi Rei
source:
Miho’s senior and roommate.

With her almond-shaped eyes, well-defined nose, and long, well-groomed black hair, she’s a beauty with the air of a young lady from a good family.

She tends to come across as harsh because she speaks her mind openly and without reservation, but she’s simply straightforward—there’s no malice behind her words.

She’s so beautiful that she stands out both on and off campus, and she was once voted “Miss Campus” in a university-wide poll.
